messages:
Devon (Nuvexa): Hi team — procurement flagged our invoice INV-8789. They won't accept it without an official PO in their system and a VAT registration certificate for our EU entity. Can you put billing on hold?

jessica_support: Hi Devon — putting INV-8789 on hold now. Can you confirm the exact PO format they need and who in procurement we should follow up with?

Devon (Nuvexa): Their AP requires PO in format 2025-NUX-XXXX and the vendor registration PDF (VAT cert). They also insist the invoice include their cost center code (CC-4301). Contact is laura.procure@nuvexa.eu.

jessica_support: Thanks. Escalating to finance and marking invoice HOLD. If procurement provides a PO today we can reissue.

marta_finance: I opened FIN-4521 to track. For clarity: we can generate a pro-forma if they need confirmation now, but we can't finalize a posted invoice to their accounting without the PO + VAT doc.

simon_sales: Looping in procurement contact — I've DM'd Laura to confirm they'll upload the PO and vendor cert to their portal.

invoice-bot: Invoice INV-8789 status change: POSTED -> HOLD (reason: awaiting PO and VAT registration). Ticket: FIN-4521.

Devon (Nuvexa): Appreciate it. Procurement says they will upload PO 2025-NUX-998 and the VAT cert by end of day. Please advise if we need to re-submit any billing details (billing address / tax name).

marta_finance: Once we receive PO and VAT cert we'll void the held invoice and reissue a corrected invoice including PO#, cost center, and the VAT registration details. Expect reissue within 24 hours of receiving docs. We'll confirm here when done.

jessica_support: Noted — holding until FIN-4521 closed. If they need immediate access, we can accept a one-time card payment but that won't reconcile with their PO-based AP workflow.

Devon (Nuvexa): Understood. They'll stick with PO. I'll post here when uploaded. Thanks.

(45 minutes later)

Devon (Nuvexa): Update — PO 2025-NUX-998 and the VAT registration PDF uploaded to their portal (email confirmation attached). Please confirm when invoice is reissued.

marta_finance: Confirmed receipt on FIN-4521. Reissuing invoice now to include PO 2025-NUX-998 and cost center CC-4301; TAX info pulled from uploaded cert. New invoice will reference INV-8789-R1.

invoice-bot: Invoice INV-8789 status change: HOLD -> REISSUED (new_id: INV-8789-R1). Ticket FIN-4521 closed.

Devon (Nuvexa): Thanks all — procurement confirmed receipt of the updated invoice and will process payment per their net-30 terms. :thumbsup:
